verified: Alibaba reported fiscal second-quarter revenue up 10% year over year to about $40.7B, ahead of the roughly $40.41B consensus of three analysts surveyed by Zacks, and profit roughly tripled from a year earlier, per the Wall Street Journal's Tracy Qu and an Associated Press earnings snapshot. The Wall Street Journal also reported that Alibaba is preparing a Hong Kong listing for its chip unit, T-Head.
unconfirmed: The two accounts differ on the profit figure — the Journal puts net profit at about $9.68B, while the AP snapshot cites $9.63B — and the Journal's claim that this beat a roughly $3.6B analyst estimate is not corroborated by the AP report, which gives no comparable profit consensus. Neither account breaks out how much of the profit gain came from AI versus e-commerce, and no timetable, size or valuation has been disclosed for the T-Head listing.

verified: 阿里巴巴公布财年第二季度（9月止）业绩，营收同比增长10%至约407亿美元，净利润同比增长约三倍；美联社（经雅虎财经转载）给出的净利润为96.3亿美元，并称接受 Zacks 调查的三位分析师预期营收为404.1亿美元。公司同时表示正为芯片部门平头哥（T-Head）筹备香港上市。
unconfirmed: 约96.8亿美元的净利润与“约36亿美元”的利润预期出自《华尔街日报》报道及 Techmeme 摘要，而美联社给出的净利润为96.3亿美元，两个口径存在小幅差异，无法判断哪一方为最终数字；财报未单独披露 AI 业务的营收或利润，“AI 盈利能力改善”属公司口径表述，尚无独立测算；平头哥上市的时间表、募资规模与估值均未公布。

titles.en: Alibaba Q2 net profit triples to ~$9.68B on AI, e-commerce gains, WSJ reports
titles.zh: 阿里巴巴第二财季营收增10%、净利增至三倍，AI与电商盈利改善
